traits.name: Lightning Drinker
traits.text: Whenever a yamaraj would take electricity damage if not for its immunity, its fast healing increases to 40 on its next turn. During that turn, if it uses its breath weapon, the beetles crackle with electricity and deal 2d12 (2d12) additional electricity damage.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: ⬺ (divine, evocation); The yamaraj breathes a blast of beetles in a 50-foot cone that deals 14d8 (14d8) slashing damage and 4d8 (4d8) persistent slashing damage to creatures in the area (DC 42 Reflex save). It can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds. Critical Success The creature takes no damage. Success The creature takes half damage and is sickened 1. Failure The creature takes full damage and is sickened 2. Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is sickened 3.

traits.name: Final Judgment
traits.text: A yamaraj's miracle spells are used only to pronounce judgment, typically either to restore a dead or destroyed creature to life, bind a creature to the Boneyard, or banish a creature from the Boneyard.

traits.name: Spirit Touch
traits.text: A yamaraj's Strikes affect incorporeal creatures with the effects of a ghost touch property rune and deal 3d6 (3d6) negative damage to living creatures and 3d6 (3d6) positive damage to undead.

traits.name: Yamaraj Venom
traits.text: (poison); Saving Throw DC 42 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 10 rounds Stage 1 3d8 (3d8) poison damage and clumsy 1 (1 round) Stage 2 5d8 (5d8) poison damage and clumsy 2 (1 round) Stage 3 7d8 (7d8) poison damage and clumsy 3 (1 round)
